description: List the pages of a website from its sitemaps: finds them via robots.txt or common paths, follows sitemap indexes, reads gzip, text and feed sitemaps, returns URLs with lastmod. Free: up to 2,000 URLs from 12 sitemap files. With bulk=true: up to 5,000 URLs from 20 files for $0.004 USDC. Paid calls made without a payment return isError with the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (amount in USDC atomic units, network, payTo, HTTP endpoint); retry with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Invalid input and calls where every item fails are never charged. Fetches follow robots.txt, use the User-Agent AdamHaleTools/1.0 and refuse private or internal addresses.

url.description: A domain (sitemaps are discovered) or the URL of one sitemap file, e.g. "github.blog".

x402_payment.description: Optional, paid tier only: a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 (the value an HTTP client sends as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Prefer params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key or seed phrase.
